name: ogbl-collab: Academic Collaboration Link Prediction
description: The ogbl-collab dataset is an undirected, weighted graph representing an author collaboration network extracted from the Microsoft Academic Graph (MAG). Nodes represent 235,868 authors, and edges represent 1,285,465 collaboration relationships between authors who have co-authored at least one paper. Edge features include the number of co-authored papers and publication year. The task is to predict future collaborations (link prediction) evaluated by Hits@50 under a chronological split: collaborations before 2017 for training, 2018 for validation, and 2019 for testing.
